utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’m still lining up the details for Saturday on the front porch, so I’d appreciate having you there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch and can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — what time do you need me on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can swing by around 10 Saturday morning and help out on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia, I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch and could really use a few helpers. Would you be able to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I can help on Saturday at the front porch. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik said he can help this Saturday on the front porch, so that’s one more helper lined up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, glad Vik can make it. I’m still in for Saturday on the front porch, and I can help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, what time do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mina — could you come by around 10 in the morning? That’d help a lot on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik, that helps a lot. I’ll count you in for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out, just tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Just show up Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll put you where you’re needed most.
